glossary.entries.bench.body.0: An interactive bench shows an image-processing effect with controls you can drag, turn, or adjust.
glossary.entries.bench.body.1: On a black-box bench, select inputs and compare them with their outputs to identify the observed transformation.
glossary.entries.bench.title: Interactive benches
glossary.entries.details.body.0: The test panel lists every test; pick one to see its details: the input, the expected output, your output, and an error map marking which cells are outside the tolerance. A failing test says why, such as how many pixels are outside the tolerance, or that the size is wrong.
glossary.entries.details.body.1: Hover over a picture to read the value in each cell and the value expected there. When the output is a single number, the expected value, the allowed range and your reading are drawn on one scale; when it is a single row, it is drawn as a curve, with an allowed band round the expected curve.
glossary.entries.details.body.2: Whichever test is selected, every part on the board shows its results for that test. On a phone, tap the test tabs along the top to switch, and find the details under “Test details” in the bottom bar.
glossary.entries.details.title: Test details
glossary.entries.score.body.0: An image circuit can be scored by its part count and computation per output pixel.
glossary.entries.score.body.1: After passing the tests, you can reduce computation or part count.
glossary.entries.score.body.2: When a task specifies a limit, the circuit must satisfy it as well as pass the tests.
glossary.entries.score.title: Scoring and limits
glossary.entries.tests.body.0: Each level has a few tests, and each test is an input with its expected output. Your output is compared with the expected one cell by cell: each cell may be off by a tiny amount (the tolerance), and the size must match too. Some levels let a few cells be wrong.
glossary.entries.tests.body.1: The results on the parts update all the time, but whether they pass only counts once you press “Run tests”. When every test passes, the level is complete; if not, the first failing test is selected for you. After any change to the circuit, the tests need running again.
glossary.entries.tests.body.2: Many levels also have hidden tests: they are checked on every run, but you only learn how many failed, and they are shown once you pass. If every visible test passes but a hidden one fails, your circuit may only happen to work on those particular pictures.
glossary.entries.tests.title: Tests and hidden tests
glossary.entries.training.body.0: With learnable parts, some weights in a circuit are no longer filled in by you but tuned by the machine. Whenever a circuit contains such a part, two buttons appear: “Train 1 step” and “Train 10 steps”.
glossary.entries.training.body.1: Each training step nudges every learnable weight a little in the direction that makes the error smaller. The loss curve beside the buttons shows how the error changes, on a log scale.
glossary.entries.training.body.2: Training only sees the visible tests, so the hidden tests check whether what it learned also holds for new pictures. Clearing the circuit starts the weights and the loss curve afresh.
glossary.entries.training.body.3: Some levels list a few "new samples": they take no part in training and are only checked, and the panel draws an extra error line for them. Some levels let you choose the learning rate yourself: how big each step is.
glossary.entries.training.title: Training
glossary.entries.views.body.0: The same data can be viewed as a readout, waveform, grayscale image, relief, cross-section, spectrum, or gradient.
glossary.entries.views.body.1: Choose a view to inspect different features of the data, such as changes in brightness or frequency strength.
glossary.entries.views.body.2: Change the view for one part or the whole canvas. This leaves the circuit unchanged.
glossary.entries.views.title: Views
package.desc: Provides wireable image operations, probes, and interactive experiments.
package.title: Image circuits

ui.3×3 核，权重由训练决定: 3×3 kernel whose weights are set by training
ui.Harris 角点响应：两个方向都在变的地方是正的大数，直边上是负的: Harris corner response: large and positive where the picture changes in both directions, negative along straight edges
ui.一个斑点 → 两个数：它在左右、上下的位置: One blob → two numbers: where it is left–right and up–down
ui.一个核横跨 R、G、B：3×3×3 个可学习权重: One kernel spans R, G and B: 3×3×3 learnable weights
ui.一个由训练决定的数。和一张图相加、相乘时，它用在每一格上: A number that training sets. Added to or multiplied with a picture, it applies to every cell
ui.一种感光元件对一条光谱的读数：光谱乘上它的灵敏度曲线，再求平均: What one kind of sensor reads from a spectrum: the spectrum times its sensitivity curve, averaged
ui.一道 32 个点的波：cos 或 sin(2π·k·x/32)，在 −1 和 1: A wave of 32 points: cos or sin(2π·k·x/32), swinging between −1 and 1
ui.两个可训练的数：分布有多散: Two trainable numbers: how spread out the distribution is
ui.两个可训练的数：分布的中心: Two trainable numbers: the centre of the distribution
ui.两个数 → 一个斑点：z₁ 管左右，z₂ 管上下: Two numbers → one blob: z₁ moves it left–right, z₂ up–down
ui.两张图逐像素相乘：a × b: Multiplies two pictures pixel by pixel: a × b
ui.两张图逐像素相减：a − b: Subtracts two pictures pixel by pixel: a − b
ui.两张图逐像素相加、相减、相乘或相除。可将左侧或右侧设为常数，另一侧接线输入: Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides two pictures pixel by pixel. Either side can be set to a constant; the other receives a wire
ui.两张图逐像素相加：a + b: Adds two pictures pixel by pixel: a + b
ui.两张图逐格取较大的那个: Takes the larger of two pictures, cell by cell
ui.中心化、取对数的幅度谱：中心是平均亮度，越往外变化越快: The centred, log-scaled magnitude spectrum: the centre is the average brightness, and further out means faster change
ui.亮于 0.5 的每个点给经过它的所有直线 x·cosθ + y·sinθ = ρ: Every point brighter than 0.5 votes for each line x·cosθ + y·sinθ = ρ through it: across is θ (16 cells, 0° … 180°), down is ρ (2 pixels a cell)
ui.切成 P×P 图块；每块按 softmax(q·k/√d) 对所有块的 v 加权: Cuts the image into P×P patches; each patch takes the average of every patch's v, weighted by softmax(q·k/√d). With only Q wired, K and V use it too
ui.参数台（转旋钮），不接电路: a parameter bench (turning knobs); no board to wire
ui.反射率 × (法线 · 灯的方向)，背光的地方是 0: Reflectance × (normal · lamp direction), 0 where the surface faces away
ui.变换到频域，乘一个以中心为圆心的掩膜，再变换回来: Transforms to the frequency domain, multiplies by a mask centred on the middle, and transforms back
ui.可学习 3×3 核，从一组很小的随机数开始: Learnable 3×3 kernel, starting from a set of very small random numbers
ui.可学习的权重 w 和偏置 b: Learnable weight w and bias b
ui.同一行画成像素: The same row drawn as pixels
ui.图像没有经过编码器: The image does not pass through the encoder
ui.在亮于 0.5 的点里，k 轮各抽两点连线、数离线不到 δ 的点，留下支持最多的: Among the points brighter than 0.5, k rounds each join two random points and count the points closer than δ; the best line is refitted on its inliers and drawn (cells closer than 0.7 are 1)
ui.始终输出同一个数。与图相加或相乘时，这个数作用于每一格: Always outputs the same number. Added to or multiplied with a picture, it applies to every cell
ui.尺寸翻倍：每个像素放在 2×2 的左上角，其余三格补 0: Doubles the size: each pixel goes in the top left of a 2×2 block, the other three are 0
ui.左右图逐行匹配，输出视差，窗口可选: Matches the left and right images row by row and outputs disparity; window size selectable
ui.左右拖动孔板和屏幕 · 单位 mm: Drag the plate and screen sideways · units: mm
ui.左右拖动孔板和屏幕（也可聚焦后按方向键，按住 Shift 每次移动 10 mm）: Drag the plate and screen sideways (or focus one and use the arrow keys; Shift moves 10 mm)
ui.把一列数平均成一个数: Averages a row of numbers into a single number
ui.把两个或三个分数转成总和为 1 的权重。第三输入可留空，此时第三输出为 0。: Turns two or three scores into weights that sum to 1. Leave the third input empty for two scores; its output is then 0.
ui.把图变到频域，每个频率乘上增益图里对应格子的数，再变回来。增益图和频谱画法一样：: Takes the picture into the frequency domain, multiplies each frequency by the number in the matching cell of the gain picture, and comes back. The gain picture is laid out like a spectrum: its centre is frequency (0, 0)
ui.把图变成 4×4 = 16 个特征，长度为 1：整体变亮、对比度变、挪一两格、加: Turns a picture into 4×4 = 16 features of length 1: brightening, a contrast change, a shift of a pixel or two or a little noise hardly move it
ui.把整张图压成一行 k 个数（权重靠训练）: Squeezes the whole image into a row of k numbers (weights come from training)
ui.指向某处读取数值: Point at a spot to read it
ui.按 H 把图搬到「画布」那么大的一张图上：画布上每一格取原图里 H⁻¹ 指向的那: Carries the picture by H onto a picture the size of the "canvas": each cell of the canvas takes the cell of the picture that H⁻¹ points to (the nearest one), and 0 where that falls outside
ui.探针关（用指针读像素），不接电路: a probe level (reading pixels with the pointer); no board to wire
ui.整张图平移一格；从边界移入的格子补 0: Shifts the whole picture by one pixel; cells shifted in from the border are 0
ui.有三个输入口，将接入的图逐像素相加；空置的输入口不计入: Has three inputs and adds the pictures wired into them pixel by pixel; an empty input is skipped
ui.每个 2×2 块取最大值，尺寸减半: Takes the maximum of each 2×2 block, halving the size
ui.每个像素变成 1 − 自己：亮的变暗，暗的变亮: Every pixel becomes 1 − itself: light turns dark and dark turns light
ui.每格换成它周围 3×3 九个格子的平均: Each cell becomes the average of the nine cells in the 3×3 block around it
ui.每格换成它和左右两个邻居的平均: Each cell becomes the average of itself and its left and right neighbours
ui.每算一次都重新抽一个随机数: Draws a fresh random number every time it runs
ui.每隔一个像素取一个，尺寸减半: Keeps every other pixel, halving the size
ui.点击图中的格子（电脑上也可将鼠标悬停在格子上），读取它的数值。: Tap a cell in a picture (or hover over it on a computer) to read its value.
ui.点对每 4 个数一对：(x, y) → (x′, y′)。k = 0 时用全部点: Pairs come four numbers at a time: (x, y) → (x′, y′). With k = 0 it solves from all the pairs (DLT); with k > 0 it runs RANSAC: k rounds each solve H from 4 random pairs and count the pairs it maps within 1.5 pixels, and the largest group is solved again. Outputs the 9 numbers of H
ui.用整张图的最大值填满每一格: Fills every cell with the maximum of the picture
ui.由那几个数画回一张图（权重靠训练）: Draws an image back from those numbers (weights come from training)
ui.箭头指向变亮最快的方向: Arrows point where it brightens fastest
ui.补零放大一倍，再用 3×3 的核走一遍: Zero-upsamples to twice the size, then runs a 3×3 kernel over it
ui.逐像素比较几张代价图，输出最小者的编号: Compares cost maps pixel by pixel and outputs the index of the smallest
ui.随机只从 ε 进来，μ、σ 照常求导: Randomness enters only through ε; μ and σ differentiate as usual

capability.picture.items.diagonal.about: a diagonal line from the top left to the bottom right
capability.picture.items.stepX.about: a step: left half one shade, right half another
capability.picture.items.stepY.about: a step: top half one shade, bottom half another
capability.picture.items.rampX.about: a ramp from black on the left to white on the right
capability.picture.items.rampY.about: a ramp from black at the top to white at the bottom
capability.picture.items.ramp.about: a smooth gradient over the cells: c + x·dx + y·dy
capability.picture.items.bar.about: a vertical line: one column bright, the rest dark
capability.picture.items.rect.about: a rectangle: top left (x0, y0), w wide and h high
capability.picture.items.rects.about: a few rectangles: one for each [x0, y0, width, height]
capability.picture.items.disk.about: a disc: centre (cx, cy), radius r
capability.picture.items.discs.about: a few discs: one for each [cx, cy, r]
capability.picture.items.checker.about: a checkerboard, its squares cell wide
capability.picture.items.stripes.about: stripes, one cycle every period cells: upright, or across with axis y
capability.picture.items.corner.about: a corner: the bottom right bright
capability.picture.items.speckle.about: speckles: base + amp × a random number a cell, the seed saying which
capability.picture.items.twoTone.about: two shades with grain: each cell bright or dark at random by whether it is in a shape (a disc, right of a column, slanted stripes), each with a little jitter
a disc: cx, cy, the radius squared
slanted stripes: (x + y) mod period under width
capability.picture.items.noise.about: a random texture: a random brightness a cell, the seed saying which
capability.picture.items.zonePlate.about: a zone plate: rings from (cx, cy) getting denser outwards, 0.5 ± A
capability.picture.items.fabric.about: fabric: slanted stripes, one cycle every period cells, running at angle degrees
capability.picture.items.glyph.about: a letter (or rows drawn the same way), moved and scaled
capability.picture.items.row.about: a row of numbers (a point, a line, a vector …)
capability.picture.items.blob.about: a soft blob centred on (x, y)
capability.picture.items.tile.about: a 4 × 4 pattern (one patch) at brightness hi
capability.picture.items.radius.about: the frequency radius: how far each cell is from the spectrum’s centre, frequency (0, 0)
capability.picture.items.offset.about: a picture with by added to every cell (less 0.5 centres it, as networks like)
capability.picture.items.scaled.about: a 16 × 16 picture scaled to size × size (nearest cell)
capability.picture.items.margined.about: a picture with a black margin width cells wide
capability.picture.items.noisy.about: a picture with random noise added (a sum of three random numbers, the seed saying which)
capability.picture.items.blurred.about: a picture under a Gaussian blur (σ, the edge replicated; σ = 0 is the picture itself)
capability.picture.items.screened.about: a printed picture photographed with its screen: a picture with a grating of frequency (fx, fy) on it
capability.scene.studio.label: Scenes
capability.scene.items.filter.about: a picture (or a few) in, the picture a rule makes of them out
capability.scene.items.filter.params.fie: how the output comes from the test’s pictures (in the order of the level’s inputs)
inputs every test shares (the frequency radius, say)
capability.scene.items.filter.test.field: the picture of each input, when there are several
capability.target.studio.label: Targets
capability.target.items.same.about: unchanged: the output is the input
capability.target.items.shift.about: the whole picture moved by (dx, dy), padded with 0 (or as border says)
capability.target.items.negative.about: the negative: every cell becomes 1 − itself
capability.target.items.correlate.about: a weighted sum of the neighbours (cross-correlation): the kernel row by row, its centre on the cell
capability.target.items.convolve.about: stamping with a kernel (convolution): every pixel presses the kernel’s shape, moved into place, weighted and added up
capability.target.items.gauss.about: a Gaussian blur: σ, and the kernel’s radius
capability.target.items.sharpen.about: sharpening: the picture + amount × (the picture − its Gaussian blur of σ)
capability.target.items.diffx.about: the difference across: right neighbour − itself
capability.target.items.absdiff.about: both kinds of edge: |right neighbour − itself|
capability.target.items.max.about: the larger of two pictures, cell by cell
capability.target.items.stride.about: a convolution layer of stride 2: cross-correlate with the kernel, then keep every other pixel
capability.target.items.meanBlend.about: a pull towards the 3×3 mean: a + amount × (mean − a); a negative amount sharpens
capability.target.items.ask.about: patch a asks patches a and b: the two averaged with the weights softmax(4 × average(a × each))
capability.target.items.projectedAsk.abo: produce Q, K and V with shared scalar projections, then compute two-patch attention
capability.target.items.gradientEnergy.a: sum of the mean squared gradients in both directions over a 3×3 neighbourhood
capability.target.items.corners.about: corners: where the Harris response is over threshold
capability.target.items.cornerPeaks.abou: one point a corner: the peaks of the Harris response times gain (no smaller than the 3×3 neighbours, and above `above`)
capability.target.items.upsample.about: twice the size: zero-upsampled, then cross-correlated with the kernel (a transposed convolution)
capability.target.items.cross.about: the cross product a × b of two 3-vectors
capability.target.items.meet.about: where two lines meet: the line through p and q and the line through r and s (homogeneous coordinates)
capability.target.items.gradmag.about: the gradient magnitude: √(Sobel x² + Sobel y²)
capability.target.items.lowpass.about: a low-pass in frequency: what is within radius R stays (disk cuts sharply, gauss falls smoothly)
capability.target.items.sharpness.about: sharpness: the mean of the spectrum beyond radius `beyond` from its centre
capability.target.items.descreen.about: descreening: the spectrum’s cells beyond `radius` brighter than `threshold` removed, the rest kept
capability.target.items.hybrid.about: a hybrid image: the low frequencies of A + the high frequencies of B (a Gaussian of radius R)
capability.target.items.shrink.about: shrinking: one Gaussian blur of σ (the edge replicated), then every other pixel kept, halvings times
capability.target.items.pyramid.about: an image pyramid: blur a little (σ = 1, the edge replicated) and halve, levels times
